In practice, each of the 444 records (3 BW + 34 HE subjects × 4 count levels × 3 realizations = 444) was a fresh Qwen3-VL-Plus call with a unique request_id; boxes vary slightly across r=0,1,2 (e.g., subject41/1000000: r0=(30,30,98,98), r1=(40,40,88,88)). Anchor realization=0 was not actually frozen.
mitigation: Each prompt record has unique request_id and box. Anchor realization=0 designated in headline yaml but not enforced at API call site. Effect: 444 fresh Qwen3-VL-Plus calls (vs ~148 expected with anchor caching), ~1.96 s mean latency. Records preserve full audit trail so impact is transparency, not correctness.

description: Poisson deviance and SSIM previously missing for BW (and Poisson deviance missing for HE). Backfilled via scripts/_backfill_ssim_poisson.py which loads the saved reconstruction, projects it through skimage.transform.radon (128 angles for BW, 180 angles for HE matching the saved sinograms), and computes 2*(y*log(y/y_pred) - y + y_pred). All 888 rows now have psnr, ssim, nrmse, mae, poisson_deviance, deviance_per_bin, nll_per_bin populated.
mitigation: scripts/_backfill_ssim_poisson.py fills all required metrics in metrics/per_case_metrics.csv. PSNR/SSIM/NRMSE/MAE computed vs target. Poisson deviance computed via forward projection through skimage radon with circle=True geometry, then deviance_per_bin = total/y.size, nll_per_bin = total_nll/y.size. Note: HE Poisson deviance values are large (1e5-1e7 range) because of the count scale (200k total counts × 16384 bins).
